owner_text: Morning! Tomas Brandt here, practice director at Aldermoor Physio Group. Lovely weather for the time of year, though I'm stuck indoors with the rota.
We treat patients with sports injuries, back pain and post-surgery rehab, across three sites. We've been going about twelve years.
We have 43 people on the books, clinicians and front desk together.
Oh, and our accountant says forty-seven if you add the two locums. I never know which to quote.
Forty-three. The locums aren't ours, they come through an agency.
Patients phone reception, use the patient portal, or send an email, and a few walk up to the front desk. Probably 70 on a normal day, though the physios say it feels like more.
Reception spends about 5 minutes per request finding a therapist who is free, and then roughly 3 minutes keying it in.
I'll attach our referral handling sheet, it shows the whole routine.
To repeat, mostly phone, the portal and email, nothing exotic.
Phone queues at opening time are the killer, referral letters go missing, and patients who don't show up.
When it goes wrong it's usually a referral that never arrived, or the wrong slot booked.
I'd love appointment booking, chasing referrals and reminders handled automatically, because the biggest thing for me is fewer mistakes.
The practice system has an API we've used before, and it exports CSV too. We hold patient names, their phone numbers and insurance numbers, obviously.
Yes, urgent ones come in. Same-day injury slots, and post-surgery patients calling in worried.
Budget, about 10000 USD a year. As for when we start, honestly we haven't decided, I can't say yet.
Great. What does the estimate look like for three sites?
